IsoformicExperiment: Transcript, Gene and Exon Level Data in One Object

Source: R/IsoformicExperiment-class.R
IsoformicExperiment.Rd

IsoformicExperiment is an S7 class modelled after SummarizedExperiment, but organised around transcriptomic diversity: the same samples are described at three levels that are kept consistent by construction.

  • Transcript level: assays are numeric matrices with transcript IDs as row names and sample IDs as column names (for example abundance, counts, length). All assays share the same dimnames.

  • Gene level: gene assays are derived from the transcript assays by summing the isoforms of each gene (abundance-weighted means for length), cached, and can be overridden with gene_assays<-.

  • Exon level: exon structures come from the annotation and are available through annot_data_exons(), exon_table() and exon_diversity().

Annotation is never copied into the object. The annot_path property points to an annotation directory of Parquet files created by prepare_isoformic_annotation() (a GFF3/GTF file is accepted and converted on the fly). Tables are read with DuckDB on first access and cached in memory keyed by file path, size and modification time, so a re-created annotation is picked up automatically and several objects sharing one annotation share one copy of the tables.

Derived results (gene assays, row data, isoform fractions) are cached per object in the .cache environment, keyed by a hash of their inputs, and therefore survive copies but never go stale. See clear_cache().

Objects persist to disk as a directory of Parquet files with write_isoformic() and are restored with read_isoformic().

Usage

IsoformicExperiment(
  experiment_name = NULL,
  annot_path = NULL,
  assays = list(),
  col_data = NULL,
  gene_assays = list(),
  dea = list(),
  gsea = list(),
  metadata = list(),
  data_path = NULL,
  tx_type_palette = NULL
)

Arguments

experiment_name

Single string naming the experiment.

annot_path

Annotation directory or GFF3/GTF file.

assays

Named list of transcript-level matrices (or data frames with a transcript_id column).

col_data

Data frame of sample metadata with a sample_id column (or sample IDs as row names / first column).

gene_assays

Optional named list of gene-level matrices.

dea

Optional list of differential expression results.

gsea

Optional named list of enrichment results.

metadata

Optional named list of free-form metadata.

data_path

Optional on-disk location of the experiment.

tx_type_palette

Optional named colour vector per transcript type.

Value

An IsoformicExperiment object.

Properties

experiment_name

Single string. Generated when not supplied.

annot_path

Path to the annotation directory, or NULL for an empty object.

data_path

Directory the object was written to or read from (see write_isoformic()), or NULL.

assays

Named list of transcript-level matrices.

gene_assays

Named list of gene-level matrices. Derived from assays when not set explicitly.

col_data

Tibble of sample metadata; its sample_id column matches the assay column names.

dea

List with differential expression results: det (transcripts), deg (genes) and cutoffs. Use de_tx<- and de_gene<- to set them.

gsea

Named list of enrichment result tables.

metadata

Free-form named list.

annot_metadata

Named list describing the annotation source, read from the annotation directory unless set explicitly.

tx_type_palette

Named character vector of colours per transcript type, used by all plots. Defaults to tx_type_palette().

annot_data_transcripts, annot_data_genes, annot_data_exons

Read-only, cached annotation tables.

See also

example_isoformic() for a ready-made object, read_salmon() and as_isoformic() to create one from quantifications, IsoformicExperiment-accessors for the accessor generics.

Examples

iso <- example_isoformic()
iso
#> <IsoformicExperiment> pe_placenta_example
#>   annotation : gencode_v33_example_subset (69 genes, 892 transcripts, 7,032 exons)
#>   samples    : 25 [condition]
#>   transcripts: 499 assayed from 69 genes
#>   assays     : abundance, counts
#>   gene assays: derived from transcript assays on demand
#>   DE results : det (499 transcripts), deg (69 genes)
dim(iso)
#> [1] 499  25
assay_names(iso)
#> [1] "abundance" "counts"   
head(row_data(iso))

# Subset like a SummarizedExperiment
iso[1:10, c("SRR11498039", "SRR11498063")]
#> <IsoformicExperiment> pe_placenta_example
#>   annotation : gencode_v33_example_subset (69 genes, 892 transcripts, 7,032 exons)
#>   samples    : 2 [condition]
#>   transcripts: 10 assayed from 3 genes
#>   assays     : abundance, counts
#>   gene assays: derived from transcript assays on demand
#>   DE results : det (499 transcripts), deg (69 genes)

# Build one from matrices
annot <- system.file("extdata", "example_experiment", "annotation", package = "isoformic")
tpm <- assay(iso, "abundance")[1:5, 1:3]
small <- IsoformicExperiment(
  experiment_name = "tiny",
  annot_path = annot,
  assays = list(abundance = tpm),
  col_data = data.frame(sample_id = colnames(tpm), condition = c("a", "a", "b"))
)
small
#> <IsoformicExperiment> tiny
#>   annotation : gencode_v33_example_subset (69 genes, 892 transcripts, 7,032 exons)
#>   samples    : 3 [condition]
#>   transcripts: 5 assayed from 2 genes
#>   assays     : abundance
#>   gene assays: derived from transcript assays on demand
#>   DE results : <none>
